name: qwen32-relational-natural-v1-engineering
schedule_status: Prospective draft only; source collection and passing audit must exist before preparation. No run is frozen by this file.
source_requirements_note: Require the entire 800-branch source's original global development gate to pass. The current preparer enforces a complete, bound, globally passing audit and matching generation cap; compare the expected phase, assignment count, and 20-world criteria above before freezing. Twenty worlds per cell is development validation, not full validation or confirmation. No scoped source certificate is permitted.
generation_note: Reconstruct each exact original prompt, excluding every source-generated token; generate fresh reasoning with the full 4096-token allowance. The natural executor fixes temperature 0.7 and top_p 1.0. Each prefix uses source sampling_seed plus 20000000, shared across its arms with independent row generators. Source and natural allowances must both equal 4096; no regime-change declaration is used.
arms_note: Per prefix: one baseline, one record-layer47 zero-dose sham, information +/-1, known +/-1, query +/-1, and five independent seeded-random +1 controls: 13 substantive rows. The scheduler adds three zero-dose prefill padding shams to reach 16. It then pairs two distinct prefixes from the same world and kind into batch32; all four cells of each world stay on the sole worker. Padding is checked for full token identity but never counted as an independent source or substantive causal endpoint.
scheduler_limitation_note: The current scheduler applies dose_multipliers to every fitted direction. The alternative information +/-1, known/query +1, five random +/-1 design would require per-direction doses; applying shared +/-1 instead creates 18 rows and is rejected. This draft uses supported 13+3 packing without changing the executor. Random controls have only the positive sign here, so comparisons are exploratory and cannot establish a matched bidirectional specificity claim.
dose_note: All fitted directions are normalized at runtime. Every nonzero arm uses the frozen pooled:balanced information-contrast norm at layer47/record, multiplied by its signed dose; five random controls use seeded normalized vectors and the same positive norm. Report requested and achieved geometry and any finite-precision discrepancy.
interpretation_note: Engineering and exploratory development only. Include every selected source prompt regardless of original correctness, validity, closure, or cap. Report baseline validity, accuracy, caps, wall time, and peak memory without selecting successful completions. This eight-prefix, new-question-only pilot cannot establish scientific competence, opposite-polarity specificity, or mechanism evidence. Any later scientific natural study requires a distinct passing full-cap natural engineering audit bound to the same pinned model, engine, 4096-token cap, batch32 execution, and packing policy, plus its own frozen baseline validity/competence gates. No fixed-transcript replay parity audit substitutes for this natural engineering gate. No acquisition preference or subjective-experience claim follows from this pilot. Runtime and cost require measurement; the token ceiling is not a throughput estimate.
